statement.text: Let $f(z)$ be an entire function which is not a monomial. Let $ u(r)$ count the number of $z$ with $\lvert z\rvert=r$ such that $\lvert f(z)\rvert=\max_{\lvert z\rvert=r}\lvert f(z)\rvert$. (This is a finite quantity if $f$ is not a monomial.) Is it possible for $ \limsup u(r)=\infty? $ Is it possible for $ \liminf u(r)=\infty? $

title: Erdős Problem #1117
